# O365 Service Principal Privilege Escalation

**Type:** TTP

**Author:** Dean Luxton

**Upstream version:** 4

## Description

This detection identifies when an Azure Service Principal elevates privileges by adding themself to a new app role assignment.

## MITRE ATT&CK

| ID | Technique | Tactics |
|---|---|---|
| [T1098.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1098/003/) | Additional Cloud Roles | persistence, privilege-escalation |

## Analytic Stories

- Azure Active Directory Privilege Escalation
- Office 365 Account Takeover

## Data Sources

- O365 Add app role assignment grant to user.
